# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for .github/workflows/thread_sanitizer.yml
# Each entry is a known race with an open issue; remove it once that is fixed.

# embedding with randomSeed=-1 shares the global random generator (#XXXX)
race:boost::random::detail::generate_uniform_real
# static SmartsParserParams written on every call (#XXXX)
race:RDKit::MolAlign::details::symmetrizeTerminalAtoms
# d_bestSimilarity read without the mutex (#XXXX)
race:RDKit::SynthonSpaceSearch::SynthonSpaceSearcher::getBestSimilaritySoFar
# LogStateSetter changes global logger state (#XXXX)
race:RDLog::LogStateSetter
# confsOk bits written from several embedding threads (#XXXX)
race:boost::dynamic_bitset<unsigned long, std::allocator<unsigned long> >::reference::do_reset
# embedPoints writes maxIterations in the shared EmbedParameters (#XXXX)
race:RDKit::DGeomHelpers::EmbeddingOps::embedPoints

# fixed by the ControlCHandler PR (#XXXX); remove once it is merged
race:RDKit::ControlCHandler
# Catch2 assertions on worker threads, fixed by #XXXX; remove once merged
race:Catch::RunContext
